_comment: The org's remediation posture, DECLARED. Without this file monitor/remediation-policy.mjs resolves to DEFAULT_POLICY, which is behaviourally identical to what is written here and indistinguishable from nobody having decided. These values change nothing; they state the posture so it can be argued with. Schema, enums and validation live in monitor/remediation-policy.mjs; the panel reads and writes this file via GET/POST /api/remediation-policy (session-gated, baseHash-guarded). A corrupt or invalid file THROWS rather than degrading to defaults — deleting the file is the rollback, editing it badly is not.
_authority: mode is the switch that decides whether agents may fix and merge code. Anything above hitl-item is set by editing this file, never by a panel toggle: the panel API accepts only report and hitl-item.
